senses.sense_definition: A chronic infectious disease caused by bacteria that damages nerves and skin.

examples.text: Modern medicine has made <w>leprosy</w> a curable condition with the right treatment.
Historically, people suffering from <w>leprosy</w> were often forced to live in isolation.

senses.sense_definition: Something harmful or corrupting that spreads and requires social avoidance.

examples.text: The corruption in the department was a moral <w>leprosy</w> that destroyed the organization.
He viewed the spread of the scandal as a social <w>leprosy</w> affecting everyone involved.
